visual_audit: 78/78 original-PDF pages reviewed via 13 contact sheets

key_figures.question: Q1
key_figures.figure: Fig. 5 three-method qualitative comparison + Fig. 6 post-processed Canny outputs
key_figures.role: show visual differences among Canny/K-Means/YOLO and practical Canny cleanup
key_figures.cannot_prove: which model generalizes better; no quantitative held-out mask metric is attached to the visual panels

key_figures.question: Q2
key_figures.figure: Figs. 11/15 fit overlays, Figs. 13/17 residual plots, Fig. 18 residual histograms and Table 1 R2 comparison
key_figures.role: expose heterogeneity of in-sample fit quality and compare two optimizer parameterizations
key_figures.cannot_prove: neural-network generalization, statistical significance or robustness to unseen fractures because the same traces are fitted/evaluated

key_figures.question: Q3
key_figures.figure: Figs. 22-25 sampling-density/adaptive-sampling panels and Fig. 26 area-JRC scatter
key_figures.role: make sampling sensitivity and weak area association visible
key_figures.cannot_prove: that adaptive sampling is more accurate without roughness ground truth, or that area causally improves JRC; Fig. 26 itself shows only weak association

key_figures.question: Q4
key_figures.role: communicate assumed spatial network and hotspot-driven placement
key_figures.cannot_prove: calibrated connectivity probabilities, attachment-4 fidelity or true information gain; inputs are stated to be simulated and one drilling row violates spacing

recommended_figure_rules: when choosing a practical model over a visually stronger one, show two axes: predictive metric and deployment/annotation cost
for sine fitting, overlay plus residual distribution plus rejected fits and held-out/group identity; same-data R2 is not generalization
for roughness, show the ordered physical profile and sampling locations; never infer y(x)-slope statistics from an arbitrary closed contour without validating the profile contract
for active drilling, show feasible candidate map, prior uncertainty and expected posterior uncertainty reduction; a hotspot map alone is not information gain
